description: Reports which macOS permissions relevant to this server are currently granted for the calling process: Accessibility (required for window manipulation, app hide/show), Screen Recording (required for window screenshots), Automation > Finder (required for Finder selection), and Notifications. Use this tool before attempting operations that require elevated permissions to confirm prerequisites without triggering an OS permission prompt.
name: macos_check_permissions

accessibility.description: True when Accessibility permission is granted.

automation_finder.description: True when Automation > Finder permission is granted.

calling_process.description: Name of the process that launched this server (e.g. "ghostty", "node").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notifications.description: True when notifications can be posted via osascript.

screen_recording.description: True when Screen Recording permission is granted.

title: Check macOS Permissions
